# Browser assets

The independent study site vendors these browser distributions to avoid runtime CDN requests:

- MathJax 3.2.2: `mathjax-full`, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax-src
- Mermaid 10.9.3: `mermaid`, MIT, https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid

Original licenses are retained in `licenses/`. These third-party software licenses apply to the vendored assets; the tutorial content retains the repository's CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.
